A kind reminder, before departure
A bustling lull is easier with a plan
Travelers with pets must check in early and follow the Companion Animal Travel Desk steps without delay.

Keep carriers secure, clean, and labeled before arrival. Pets must remain calm and safely contained through screening and boarding. <<FACT F064>> Staff will inspect travel gear and may refuse anything that does not meet the rules. Bring water, familiar bedding, and all required papers.

Bird carriers need careful preparation for ventilation, spacing, and stability. <<FACT F071>> Do not add loose items that could shift or injure the animal during loading. If a pet appears distressed, tell the handler at once so support can begin right away.

For urgent help, please come directly to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
